decision_scope: APPROVE_OR_REVISE_ONLY_CONSTRUCTION_OF_BATCH02_D02_AS_100_PT_EN_ESPERANTO_SEMANTIC_REFERENCE_ENTRIES; DO_NOT_CREATE_NEW_HNK_FORMS REGISTER_WAVE04 ASSIGN_HNK3000_CREDIT PROMOTE_AUTHORITY CREATE_GRAMMAR OR ALTER_L03_WITH_THIS_APPROVAL

proposed_decision.rule: Construct one governed concept per record in D02, preserving the approved level allocation and producing PT, EN and Esperanto reference fields plus ambiguity and morphology metadata. This is semantic-reference authoring only.

governance_decisions.proposal: Use D02 allocation A1=20, A2=20, B1=25, B2=35 for exactly 100 records.

Preserve and reconcile the already established D02 A1 concepts: família; progenitor/responsável parental; mãe; pai; criança/filho genérico; filho; filha; irmão; irmã; marido; esposa; parceiro(a); amigo(a); homem; mulher; menino; menina; bebê; avó; avô. Do not duplicate or silently rename them.

For every record provide concept_definition_pt, pt_reference, en_reference, eo_reference, part_of_speech, semantic_notes, Esperanto root/base, Esperanto morphology, lexicalization type, verification status, English ambiguity notes and cross-language one-to-one status.

Use Esperanto as verified semantic/morphological reference only. Retain technical or culturally sensitive kinship/relationship terms as PROVISIONAL when lexicographic confidence is insufficient; do not normalize by guess.
Existing HNK recovered/authored/selected forms may be referenced only after exact sense review; PAPA and MAMA remain HOLD/GATE-linked and must not be promoted or generalized by semantic mapping.

Run duplicate-concept, near-synonym, kinship-system, relationship-role, gender/age distinction, polysemy and one-to-one mapping review across all 100 D02 records before presenting Batch 02 for human semantic review.
After construction create a separate Batch 02 semantic-review human gate. Do not treat generated PT/EN/EO entries as fully approved until that later gate is explicitly accepted.

approval_rule: A future SIGA in this semantic-master thread may approve only DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B02-001 through DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B02-008 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same approval must not approve the generated 100 records, create HNK forms, register Wave04, assign HNK3000 credit, promote PAPA/MAMA/HOLD seeds, approve B16 or alter L03.
